gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-phoen: Funnel Display draws every letter like a single strand of spaghetti. Noto Sans Phoenician then takes over with generous lowercase height and s curves that open wide at both ends, a modern, contemporary counterweight.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-psalt: Funnel Display runs its strokes at constant width, with no quill-style tapering anywhere. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi follows with gaping mouths on the e and barely rising capitals, so paragraphs feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-rejan: Noto Sans Rejang is built on lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, with distinct gaps in c, e, s and a. Noto Sans Rejang keeps long text feeling professional and open, while Funnel Display above it skips any calligraphic shading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-runic: Expressive Funnel Display looks like twine pressed into a flat surface, every stroke the same width. And Noto Sans Runic, with its big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves, reads in a modern, steady way over a long stretch.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-samar: Noto Sans Samaritan reads sturdy and approachable, with a hefty lowercase. Funnel Display is best at a single track width like a neon sign tube, while the body font is best at giving its curves plenty of daylight inside.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-saura: Funnel Display is a commanding display face with no pinched joints or flared ends anywhere in its letters. Noto Sans Saurashtra does the quieter job: clean sans-serif text, counters open to the outside.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads neutral and modern, its chalk curves stopping well before they close and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Funnel Display adds the pair's strongest quality, a commanding texture of plain, unshaded lines.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-shara: Funnel Display looks cut from wire, each letter a single unshaded line with a commanding, expressive streak. Noto Sans Sharada sits beneath as a plain sans with bulky lowercase proportions and open c forms, giving the wire-like headings something sturdy to lean on.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-siddh: Funnel Display holds an uninterrupted line width on every letter, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Its commanding looseness against Noto Sans Siddham's large central band is the draw.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-sinha: Think sign-painter's single stroke, brushed at constant width. Noto Sans Sinhala is the reverse job: a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, plain sans in manner, while Funnel Display stays the expressive voice up top.
